q: what is the starting dose of atorvastin
answer: The starting dose of atorvastatin is 10 mg to 20 mg once daily for adults, and the dosage range is 10 mg to 80 mg once daily. For pediatric patients aged 10 years and older with HeFH (Hypofunctional Familial Hypercholesterolemia), the starting dosage is 10 mg once daily, and for HoFH (Hypolipoproteinemic Familial Hypercholesterolemia), the starting dosage is 10 mg to 20 mg once daily. q: drug interactions
answer:
Here are some drug interactions that have been reported:

- Fluoxetine can interact with monoamine oxidase inhibitors [1], tricyclic antidepressants [1][2], CNS acting drugs [1][2], benzodiazepines [1][2], antipsychotics [1][2], anticonvulsants [1][2], and serotonergic drugs [1][2]. Monitoring and caution are advised.

q: warfarin
answer: When using warfarin, there are several serious warnings and precautions [1]. Necrosis or gangrene of skin or other tissues can occur, which may require debridement or amputation [1]. Fatal and serious cases of calciphylaxis have also been reported [1]. Warfarin sodium use may cause acute kidney injury, especially during episodes of excessive anticoagulation [1]. Systemic atheroemboli and cholesterol microemboli can also occur, leading to necrosis or death [1]. Heparin-induced thrombocytopenia (HIT) can happen, and warfarin sodium may be considered after platelet count has normalized [1]. Additionally, pregnant women with mechanical heart valves should be monitored closely as warfarin sodium may cause fetal harm [1]. Major or fatal bleeding can occur with warfarin sodium, and patients should be monitored for signs of bleeding [1]. Consult a healthcare provider for further guidance [1].

q: ¿Cuáles son los efectos secundarios de la metformina?
answer: Los efectos secundarios de la metformina incluyen diarrea [1], náuseas/vómitos [1], eructación [1], malestar abdominal [1], indigestión [1], astenia [1] y dolor de cabeza [1]. También puede causar una disminución a niveles subnormales de vitamina B12 sin manifestaciones clínicas, lo que a veces puede ser reversible con la discontinuación de la metformina o la suplementación de vitamina B12 [3]. Además, la metformina puede aumentar el número de leucocitos en algunas ocasiones [3]. Estos efectos secundarios son relativamente frecuentes y generalmente no son graves. Para más información, consulte el folleto de información al paciente de la metformina [3].
